Riley: Quick brag  we just hit 42.5M requests this month! :tada: :sparkles:
Chen: WHAT. amazing. huge props to runtime + infra :clap:
Amara: tiny celebration? 15min tea & lanterns (yes, real tiny paper lanterns) at 4:30 in the lounge? :tea:
Leo: vote: jasmine tea, matcha, or both? react with :potted_plant: / :green_heart: / both if you can't decide.
Riley: also remote friends - we'll stream the 5-min photo moment. link in calendar.
OpsBot: OpsBot: Heads-up  no infra deploys scheduled 16:15-16:40 for celebration window.
Chen: shoutout to @eng-sre for the autoscaler tune that stopped the Friday spike from panicking us. bowing in advance :bow:
Amara: bringing lanterns + a tiny banner that says "42.5M tiny sparks". embarrassing puns included.
Leo: i'll bring disposable camera + stickers. also suggesting a 10s montage: each team says one word about the quarter. quick and chaotic.
Riley: playlist rule: bring one weird karaoke pick. i'll start: "I Want It That Way" :notes:
Chen: adding "Take On Me" because of course :musical_note:
Amara: micro-agenda: 16:30 tea + photos, 16:38 30s shoutouts, 16:40 group pic. remote join link enabled.
HypeBot: HypeBot: Milestone card prepared. Auto-post scheduled in #announcements at 17:00 with team photo tag.
Leo: tiny award idea: Sticky Note Trophy for the most heroic PR review. nominations?
Riley: nominating @Chen for the midnight hotfix that saved a demo.
Chen: honored but also owed cupcakes as tribute. :cupcake:
Amara: see you all later! proud of this crew. :heart:
